VZEROALL                                                                                      Zero
                                                                                  All YMM Registers
Clears YMM0–15/ZMM0–15 registers.
In 64-bit mode, YMM0–15/ZMM0–15 are all cleared (set to all zeros). In legacy and compatibility
modes, only YMM0–7/ZMM0–7 are cleared. The contents of the MXCSR is unaffected. ZMM16–31
are unaffected.
